map.表示约 270 例同类孕妇中有 1 例受累胎儿，是传统中孕筛查的高风险截断值；≥: It means about 1 in 270 comparable pregnancies has an affected fetus, which is the traditional high-risk cut-off for second trimester screening; >=1/270 is judged high risk and needs further diagnostic testing.
map.风险 1/270 是什么意思？: What does a risk of 1/270 mean?
map.风险值 = 背景风险(实龄/体重/孕周) × MoM 校正；MoM = 实测值: Risk value = background risk (age/weight/gestational age) x MoM correction; MoM = measured value / median for the same age (AFP, free beta-hCG)
map.：孕妇 30 岁、体重 60kg、孕 16 周、AFP 1.0 MoM、free: : a 30-year-old pregnant woman, weight 60 kg, 16 weeks pregnant, AFP 1.0 MoM, free beta-hCG 1.5 MoM: the age background risk is about 1/963 and the combined likelihood ratio ≈1.0, so posterior ≈ 1/963, below 1/1000, which is low risk.
map.：若 free β-hCG 升至 2.5 MoM（似然比升约 4），poster: : if free beta-hCG rises to 2.5 MoM (the likelihood ratio rises about 4-fold), posterior ≈ 1/240, which crosses the 1/270 cut-off and enters high risk; amniocentesis or non-invasive confirmation is advised.
